segments.text: V. 2. It ſeems Martha was a Perſon of ſome Figure, from the great Reſpect which was paid to her and her Siſter, in Viſits and Condola••cs on Lazarus's Death, as well as from the coſtly Ointment mentioned in the next Verſe. And probably it was at their Houſe our LORD and his Diſciples lodged, when He returned ••rn Jeruſalem to Bethany, every Evening of the laſt Week of his Life, upon which He was now entered.
